definition: latest-parent DAG critical path; emitted DeepStack ideal and bank-penalty fields; remaining memory resource wait is queue/residual
limitations: Critical-path attribution, not sum of all device busy time.
Bank queue/residual includes memory-resource waiting not explained by emitted per-op DeepStack ideal and mapping/row penalty.
NoC and DMA resource wait are assigned to their respective operation classes; compute wait and barriers are Sync/other.
